changes: Tightened system-locked phrase to whitespace-separated words, excluding the package-system-locked executable name.
Replaced the broad ET_DYN plus VDSO string identity composite with a parsed ELF SONAME observation in metadata/binary/linking/runtime.
Corrected the Linux VDSO entry-point string description and made this syscall-interface reference notable outside Go runtime inventory; retained the baseline Go-runtime downgrade.
Moved GETREGSET/SETREGSET with PRSTATUS text and POKETEXT constant references from process-hiding/injection objectives to process/attach/debugger, preserving their matchers and scopes.
Moved process_vm_writev reference observations to mem/write/arbitrary, preserving scope and exclusions; these references establish a capability, not evasion or execution transfer.
Removed the unused any-one injection-intent umbrella; updated exact consumers in hiding, procfs injection and Cobalt Strike composites.
controls: All 11 positive/near-miss controls passed: lockscreen prose versus hyphenated program name, register read/write versus other requests, declared VDSO SONAME versus client SONAME, POKE versus PEEK constant, and process_vm_writev versus process_vm_readv. Full validation initially caught a Go runtime-inventory severity regression; the existing Go baseline downgrade was restored.
limits: All listed stranded members contain attack implementation or attack payload bytes; none is inert documentation or an ordinary support library. Judgements are independent of enclosing convictions.
Some legacy source contains syntax defects; the judgement identifies attack implementation and does not assert successful execution as shipped.
Atomscan ML verdicts sometimes remain benign despite 2-4 hostile YAML findings; changing model calibration is outside this traits repository.
Binwalk is unavailable; archive bytes were inspected with ar-compatible extraction and Python tar/zip/gzip.

Fetched Ruby members were recovered from upstream and verified against the supplied SHA-256. Physical Debian extraction omits the archive data/ prefix; markers are beside the hash-verified extracted files.
verification: All 50 individually scanned members (44 stranded plus 6 supporting) retain 2-4 hostile traits; the WAR embedded JSP and byte-identical fetched dependency exploit are additionally scanned, extracted and marked. Every member SHA-256 matches the recorded specimen. Native payloads were inspected with rizin; script dispatch and exploit chains reviewed from source and cleave facts.

migration_review.destinations: Existing admitted leaves: process/attach/debugger, mem/write/arbitrary and binary/linking/runtime. No new taxonomy directories.
migration_review.consumer_audit: Exact old references updated. Broader legacy objective selectors intentionally cease treating generic ptrace/VDSO evidence as hiding or evasion. Existing neutral debugger/memory selectors gain correctly placed observations.
migration_review.placement_vs_detection: Ptrace matchers, type scopes and exclusions preserved; attack mappings removed and capability criticality corrected to notable. VDSO and lockscreen matcher corrections are independently tested.
